keywords: aadhaar card update, aadhaar address change, uidai, aadhaar correction, aadhaar download
intro: आधार कार्ड भारत में सबसे ज़रूरी identity document है। इसमें address, name, mobile number या photo correction online या nearest Aadhaar centre से करवा सकते हैं।
docs: Registered mobile number (OTP verification ke liye)
Valid Address Proof — bank passbook / passport / bijli-paani ka bill (3 mahine purana max)
Rent agreement (govt format mein, agar rented ho)
Head of Family (HoF) ka Aadhaar — jab apna proof na ho
steps: myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in kholen → Login section mein Aadhaar/VID number aur captcha daalein
Registered mobile par aaya OTP enter karke login karein
Address Update option chunein → naya poora address type karein
Address proof document upload karein (JPG/PNG, 2MB se kam, saaf readable scan)
₹50 fee UPI/Card/Netbanking se pay karein → SRN number note kar lein
SRN se status track karein; approval ke baad m-Aadhaar app mein turant updated address dikhega
timeInfo: Proof verify hone ke baad 5–7 din · e-Aadhaar turant download ho jata hai
tips: Naam life mein sirf 2 baar change hota hai; DOB sirf 1 baar valid proof ke saath
2026 mein UIDAI periodically FREE document update window kholti hai — myAadhaar dashboard check karte rahein

faq.q: Aadhaar card mein address kaise change karein?
faq.a: myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in par login karein, Address Update option chunein, naya address aur proof upload karein, ₹50 fee pay karein. 5-7 din mein update ho jayega.

faq.q: Aadhaar mobile number link kaise karein?
faq.a: Nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra jaakar mobile number update karwayein. ₹50 fee hai. Online sirf address update hota hai, mobile number ke liye physically jaana padta hai.

faq.q: e-Aadhaar download kaise karein?
faq.a: myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in par login karein ya UIDAI website se Download Aadhaar option chunein. Aadhaar number ya VID se download kar sakte hain.

faq.q: Aadhaar card free mein ban sakta hai?
faq.a: Haan, pehli baar banana free hai. Update/correction ke liye ₹50-100 fee hoti hai.

keyPoints: Bharat mein sabse zaroori identity document
Bank account, SIM card, aur government schemes ke liye zaroori
Online aur offline dono tarike se update kar sakte hain
mAadhaar app se digital version use kar sakte hain

updateLimits.name: Max 2 times in lifetime (with valid proof)

importantDates.deadline14June2027: Free document update deadline 14 June 2027 (if applicable)

childMbu: Children MBU (Multiple Biometric Update) available for children turning 5 and 15

DOB proof — Aadhaar se auto-fetch hota hai

Get New e-PAN chunein → Aadhaar number daalein → OTP verify karein

faq.a: Koi age limit nahi hai — newborn se lekar elderly tak sab ke liye PAN ban sakta hai.

faq.a: incometax.gov.in par Quick Links → Link Aadhaar par jaayein. Aadhaar number aur PAN number daalein, OTP verify karein. Agar dono naam match na karein toh pehle correction karwayein.

faq.q: Gum hua PAN card kaise dubara lein?
faq.a: incometax.gov.in par login karein → Reprint PAN Card option chunein → ₹50+50 fee pay karein → naya card ghar par aayega.

faq.q: Ek se zyada PAN hai toh kya karein?
faq.a: Voluntarily surrender karein — online portal par Return of Duplicate PAN form bharen. Nahi toh ₹10,000 tak ka penalty lag sakta hai.

keyPoints: Aadhaar se instant e-PAN free mein ban jata hai

Bank account, investment, aur property ke liye mandatory

keywords: passport apply, passport seva, passport renewal, tatkal passport, passport appointment
intro: Passport banwane ke liye online form bharna aur PSK visit karna padta hai. Normal ya Tatkal dono options available hain — documents sahi hone par process smooth hota hai.
docs: Date of Birth proof — birth certificate ya 10th certificate
Current address proof — bijli bill / bank passbook / rent agreement
Tatkal ke liye: Annexure verification certificate + 1 additional ID proof
steps: passportindia.gov.in par New User Registration karke account banayein
Login karke Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue chunein → form bharein
PSK choose karein (Jaipur/Jodhpur etc.) → fee pay karein → appointment slot book karein
Appointment day: originals + self-attested photocopy set lekar PSK 15 minute pehle pahunchein
Token lagne ke baad Counter A-B-C process: biometric + document verification hoga
Fresh application: police verification baad mein hogi; Tatkal: passport 1–3 din mein dispatch
Speed Post tracking number se delivery monitor karein
timeInfo: Normal: 7–30 din (police verification ke baad) · Tatkal: 1–3 din
tips: Slot booking free hai lekin fee payment pehle zaroori hai — slot 90 din advance tak milte hain

faq.q: Passport ke liye police verification zaruri hai?
faq.a: Haan, fresh passport ke liye police verification hoti hai. Tatkal mein pehle passport milta hai, baad mein verification hoti hai. Re-issue mein address same ho toh verification nahi hoti.

faq.q: Passport ka address Aadhaar wala hona chahiye?
faq.a: Nahi, koi bhi valid address proof chalega — bijli bill, bank passbook, rent agreement sab accepted hain.

faq.q: Minor bachche ka passport kaise banwayein?
faq.a: Dono parents ka consent chahiye. Online form bharen, PSK mein appoint le jaayein. 15 saal se kam ke bachon ke passport 5 saal ke liye valid hote hain.

faq.q: Passport kharab ho gaya hai toh kya karein?
faq.a: Re-issue ke liye apply karein — 'Reissue' reason mein 'Valid upto declared/Exhausted pages' chunein. Same process follow karein.

faq.q: Passport track kaise karein?
faq.a: passportindia.gov.in par Login → Track Application Status. Ya SMS service: SMS STATUS <space> 15-digit file number 9704100100 par bhejen.

keyPoints: Online form bharkar PSK mein appointment lena padta hai
Normal aur Tatkal dono options available hain
Documents sahi hone par process smooth hota hai
Police verification fresh passport ke liye zaroori hai

keywords: driving license apply, learner license, permanent DL, DL renewal, sarathi parivahan
intro: Learner license (LL) ke baad permanent driving license banwana Parivahan portal par online hota hai. Rajasthan mein Sarathi portal se dono ke liye apply kar sakte hain.

Medical Certificate Form 1A (40+ age ya transport DL)

Apply for Learner Licence → Aadhaar e-KYC se form auto-fill karein
LL test slot book karein — kai states ab ghar se online test bhi deti hain

faq.q: Learner license ke baad kitne din mein permanent DL ke liye apply karein?
faq.a: Kam se kam 30 din baad aur maximum 6 mahine ke andar apply karna hota hai. Is period ke bahar apply nahi hoga.

faq.q: DL renewal ki age kitni hai?
faq.a: Non-transport DL: 40 tak 20 saal, phir 5-5 saal. Transport DL: 40 tak 10 saal, phir har 5 saal medical ke saath.

faq.q: Online LL test kaise hota hai?
faq.a: Sarathi portal par slot book karein. Webcam on karna hai, screen share hota hai. 15 MCQ sawaal aate hain, 9 sahi hone chahiye.

faq.q: Gaadi ka paper hona chahiye DL test ke liye?
faq.a: Nahi, gaadi LMV category ki honi chahiye. Own car, driving school car ya kisi ka bhi chalega — registration papers driver ke naam nahi chahiye.

faq.a: Pehle Jan Aadhaar mein naya member add karein, phir ration card portal par update request karein. Jan Aadhaar ke bina ration card mein member nahi jud sakta.

keywords: itr filing, income tax return, itr 2026, itr online, tax refund
intro: Income Tax Return bharna portal par kaafi simple ho gaya hai — pre-filled data auto-fetch hota hai. Sahi ITR form chunna aur regime compare karna zaroori hai.
docs: Investment proofs — 80C (LIC/PPF/ELSS), HRA receipts, home loan interest
steps: incometax.gov.in login karein → e-File → Income Tax Returns → File New Return
AY 2026-27 select karein → Online Mode → applicable person: Individual

New regime mein standard deduction ₹75,000 milega (salaried)

faq.q: ITR bharna zaruri hai?
faq.a: Agar income basic exemption limit se zyada hai toh zaruri hai. Salary ke liye ₹3 lakh, senior citizen ke liye ₹5 lakh se zyada income par ITR mandatory hai.

faq.q: ITR file karne ki last date kab hai?
faq.a: Non-audit cases ke liye 31 July 2026. Audit cases ke liye 31 October. Revised return 31 December tak file kar sakte hain.

faq.q: Refund kab tak aata hai?
faq.a: e-Verify karne ke baad 20-45 din mein refund bank account mein credit hota hai. inttax.gov.in par status check kar sakte hain.

faq.q: New Regime ya Old Regime — kaunsa best hai?
faq.a: Deductions zyada hain toh Old Regime best hai. Bilkul deductions nahi hain toh New Regime. Portal par dono ka tax auto-compare hota hai.

intro: Ayushman Bharat se ₹5 lakh tak ka cashless treatment milta hai eligible families ko. 2026 mein ABHA health ID bhi isi portal se free mein ban jati hai.

faq.q: Ayushman card ke liye kaun eligible hai?
faq.a: SECC 2011 deprivation list mein jo families hain unko free cover milta hai. Rural: 14 parameters, Urban: 11 parameters. Portal par eligibility check kar sakte hain.

faq.q: Ayushman card se kya hota hai?
faq.a: ₹5 lakh tak ka cashless treatment milta hai empanelled hospitals mein. Pre-existing diseases bhi day 1 se covered hain.

faq.q: Private hospital bhi covered hai?
faq.a: Haan, jo private hospitals government se empanelled hain unmein cashless treatment milta hai. pmjay.gov.in par city-wise hospital list dekhein.

faq.a: ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) ek health ID hai jo har koi bana sakta hai. Ayushman card sirf eligible families ke liye hai jismein ₹5 lakh cover milta hai.

faq.q: Revaluation mein marks badh sakte hain?
faq.a: Haan, kai baar marks badh jaate hain. Lekin revaluation mein marks kam bhi ho sakte hain. Scrutiny (retotalling) mein sirf addition check hota hai — marks kam nahi honge. Per subject ₹300–500 fee hai.

faq.a: Result declare hone ke ~3 hafte baad school se mil jati hai. Tab tak digital copy DigiLocker se download kar sakte hain.

faq.q: Back paper form kab bharna hai?

faq.q: 2026-27 se supplementary exams kyun band ho rahe hain?
